27: def sendEmail(sydent, templateName, mailTo, substitutions):
28:         mailFrom = sydent.cfg.get('email', 'email.from')
29:         mailTemplateFile = sydent.cfg.get('email', templateName)
30:         allSubstitutions = {
31:             'date': email.utils.formatdate(localtime=False),
32:             'to': mailTo,
33:             'from': mailFrom,
34:         }
35:         allSubstitutions.update(substitutions)
36:         mailString = open(mailTemplateFile).read() % allSubstitutions
37:         rawFrom = email.utils.parseaddr(mailFrom)[1]
38:         rawTo = email.utils.parseaddr(mailTo)[1]
39:         if rawFrom == '' or rawTo == '':
40:             logger.info("Couldn't parse from / to address %s / %s", mailFrom, mailTo)
41:             raise EmailAddressException()
42:         mailServer = sydent.cfg.get('email', 'email.smtphost')
43:         logger.info("Sending mail to %s with mail server: %s" % (mailTo, mailServer,))
44:         try:
45:             smtp = smtplib.SMTP(mailServer)
46:             smtp.sendmail(rawFrom, rawTo, mailString)
47:             smtp.quit()
48:         except Exception as origException:
49:             twisted.python.log.err()
50:             ese = EmailSendException()
51:             ese.cause = origException
52:             raise ese
